Commentator Candace Owens joins Tucker Carlson for a wide talk that starts with French president Macron and Harvey Weinstein. The title also names her phrase Christ Is King and why it broke people's brains, in her words. Owens is a sharp voice on the right.

Owens tells her side of the feuds that made her a target in the press. She explains what she meant by Christ Is King and why the phrase caused such a storm. Carlson draws out her views on faith and fame. Listeners get Owens in her own words at length. The talk is warm at times and fierce at others.
